# LReaParams 0.0.63
This release introduces major improvements to FX and Track parameter management, accessibility, keyboard navigation, parameter groups, memories, and legacy profile importing.
Based on the latest TEST62.9.2 development version.
### What's New
**FX Parameters and Groups** - Improved management of Custom Order and 12 independent parameter groups. - Each group preserves its own navigation grid and parameter positions. - Plugin Order always displays the original parameter list. - Improved copying, moving, and reordering of parameters between groups. - Global hidden parameters can be restored individually through FX Memories. - Improved parameter deletion and focus restoration. - Empty groups can be saved and recalled.
**FX and Track Memories** - Improved management of copied parameters, hidden parameters, and parameter steps. - Multiple memory entries can be selected and managed together. - New keyboard navigation options for selected memory entries. - Improved group identification and parameter occurrence tracking.
**Incremental Keyboard Search** - New incremental search across FX Parameters, Track Parameters, and memory managers. - Supports multiple characters, numbers, punctuation, and word prefixes. - Search resets after one second of inactivity. - Shift enables reverse searching. - Improved compatibility with Italian and European keyboard layouts.
**FX Chain Integration** - Press Alt+P in the native REAPER FX Chain list to open LReaParams FX Parameters for the highlighted plugin. - Existing REAPER keyboard shortcuts remain available outside this context.
**Legacy Profile Import** - New action: "LReaParams: Import selected legacy TXT files". - Import individual or multiple legacy Lua FX and Track parameter profiles. - Original TXT files are preserved. - Existing native profiles are protected against accidental overwriting.
**Documentation and Installation** - Updated accessible offline HTML guides in seven languages. - Updated About dialog and version information. - Updated Windows installer and GitHub Actions configuration. - Existing user profiles and settings are preserved.
### Installation
Download the Windows installer from the assets below.
Run the installer and select your REAPER resource directory. Portable REAPER installations are also supported.
After installation, restart REAPER.
LReaParams actions can be found in the REAPER Action List by searching for "LReaParams".
The extension also provides its own submenu under:
Extensions > LReaParams
### Accessibility
Designed for accessible keyboard-driven operation in REAPER, particularly with NVDA and OSARA.
The project focuses on giving users greater control over plugin parameters, navigation, organization, automation, and workflow accessibility.
### Source Code
The complete source code is available in this GitHub repository.
**Thank you for using LReaParams!**
Lo-lo

# LReaParams 0.0.65
## What's New
### New Keyboard Theme
Introduced a new keyboard-based parameter control system, designed to provide a faster, hardware-like workflow for REAPER FX.
- **Two selectable themes:** Standard and Keyboard. - **F4** instantly switches between themes without changing the selected parameter or its step size. - Independent theme preferences for all 14 FX contexts: Plugin Order, Custom Order, and 12 custom groups. - Each context remembers its own theme, automatically restoring it when selected. - Direct access to 36 parameters using the number and letter keys. - **Alt+Up/Down** navigates between pages of 36 parameters. - Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home, and End provide immediate parameter adjustment. - Improved Page Up/Down step calibration for both Standard Value and Keyboard. - Unassigned keys remain silent.
### Full Keyboard Shortcut Compatibility
Existing LReaParams shortcuts remain available, including:
- Ctrl+B for FX bypass. - Ctrl+Shift+D for Delta. - Ctrl+Page Up/Down and other existing navigation commands. - F7 parameter organization and editing, which remains exclusively in Standard mode.
### Additional Improvements
- Preserved the iZotope RX parameter readback compatibility fix. - Updated the About dialog to version 0.0.65. - Updated accessible documentation in seven languages. - Preserved existing FX profiles, custom groups, and parameter memories.
## Installation
Download the Windows x64 Setup ZIP, extract it, close REAPER, and run the included installer.
Compatible with standard and portable REAPER installations.
## ReaPack
LReaParams can also be installed and updated through ReaPack.
Repository URL:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lo-lo78/LReaParams/main/index.xml
The Windows x64 DLL and ReaPack index are automatically published through GitHub Actions when a stable release is published.
## Compatibility
- Windows x64 - REAPER x64 - NVDA and OSARA

GPL-3.0
Thank you for using LReaParams!

# LReaParams 0.0.67 – Independent Grid and Step Resets
This release improves keyboard control and accessibility in FX Params by separating parameter, step, and grid reset operations.
### What's new
- **Backspace:** Reset the current parameter to its default value. - **Ctrl+Backspace:** Reset only the current parameter step. - **Shift+Backspace:** Reset only the current grid to 10 columns. - **Double Shift+Backspace:** Open an accessible numeric editor to set the grid size from 1 to 400. - **Ctrl+Shift+Backspace:** Reset all plugin parameter values.
The F3 status announcement continues to report Grid, Step, and the current Group slots or Memory slots mode.
### Compatibility
- Preserves 14 independent grid configurations. - Maintains existing FX profiles, groups, memories, and saved settings. - Retains Standard and Keyboard themes. - Includes the previous accessibility improvements for NVDA and OSARA. - Updates the About dialog and multilingual documentation. - Preserves compatibility with the existing ReaPack repository.
### Installation
Download the Windows x64 setup package, extract it, close REAPER, and run the installer.
Alternatively, install or update LReaParams through ReaPack after the repository index has been refreshed.
**Platform:** Windows x64 **License:** GPL-3.0 **Source code:** https://github.com/Lo-lo78/LReaParams

# LReaParams 0.0.68 — Used Parameters
This release introduces the new **Used (Usati)** virtual FX parameter view, providing fast access to parameters modified through LReaParams.
## What's New
- **Ctrl+Shift+L:** Toggle between Used and the previous Plugin Order, Custom Order or Group context. - **Automatic collection:** Modified parameters are added to Used once, in first-edit order, without duplicates. - **Ctrl+Delete in Used:** Remove a parameter from the collection without changing its value. - **Independent settings:** Used has its own Grid, cursor and Standard/Keyboard theme. - **Project persistence:** Used parameters are stored independently for each FX instance in the REAPER project. - Preset loading and playback automation do not automatically populate Used.
## Compatibility
- Preserves the existing 14 FX contexts and 12 custom groups. - Retains all independent Grid and Step controls introduced in 0.0.67. - Preserves F3 announcements, F7 Standard mode, FX profiles and parameter memories. - Maintains NVDA and OSARA accessibility. - Includes updated multilingual documentation. - Preserves historical ReaPack releases.
## Installation
Download the Windows x64 Setup ZIP, extract it, close REAPER and run the installer.
Alternatively, update through the existing LReaParams ReaPack repository after publication completes.
**Platform:** Windows x64 / REAPER x64 **License:** GPL-3.0 **Source code:** https://github.com/Lo-lo78/LReaParams

# LReaParams 0.0.69 — Used in F7 and Persistent Used View
This release improves the Used (Usati) virtual parameter view, with faster group creation and persistent navigation.
## What's New
- **Persistent Used View:** Pressing Escape preserves Used and the current parameter position. Reopening the same FX restores the previous view. - **Ctrl+L in Used:** Returns directly to the previous context without unrelated Custom Order messages. - **Ctrl+Shift+L in F7:** Switches between Used and the previous editing context. - **Used Selection in F7:** Select parameters using Shift+Space, Shift+Arrow keys or Ctrl+A. - **Copy to Groups:** Ctrl+C copies selected Used parameters, allowing them to be pasted into custom groups. - **Group Creation:** Selected parameters can be saved directly to an available group slot using Ctrl+Shift+F1–F12. - **Safe Ctrl+Delete:** In F7/Used, it does not remove Used entries or modify underlying groups. Outside F7, its original Used removal behavior is preserved.
## Accessibility and Compatibility
- Preserves all existing FX parameter memories, profiles and custom groups. - Maintains independent Grid and Standard/Keyboard settings. - Preserves the F3 Grid, Step and Group slots / Memory slots announcements. - Maintains compatibility with NVDA and OSARA. - Keeps existing Used collections and project persistence. - Includes updated multilingual accessibility documentation. - Preserves historical ReaPack releases.
## Installation
Download the Windows x64 Setup ZIP, extract it, close REAPER and run the installer.
Alternatively, update using the existing LReaParams ReaPack repository after publication completes.
**Platform:** Windows x64 / REAPER x64 **License:** GPL-3.0-only **Source code:** https://github.com/Lo-lo78/LReaParams

# LReaParams 0.0.70 — Accessible Preferences, Customizable Titles and Multi-Track Selection
**Release date:** 15 November 2026. **Platform:** REAPER x64 on Windows x64. **License:** GPL-3.0-only.
## New: native, accessible Preferences
- New REAPER action: **LReaParams: Preferences** (`_LREAPARAMSPREFERENCES`). The existing **LReaParams: Settings (Keyboard Input)** (`_LREAPARAMSSETTINGS`) stays available separately. - Tree navigation: **Messages** (FX Params / Track Params), **Shortcuts** (FX Params / Track Params) and **Advanced**. Tab moves into the selected page and then to OK, Cancel and back to the tree. Shift+Tab moves backwards. The last tree item is remembered for the current REAPER session. - **Ctrl+P** opens Preferences in either navigator without losing the current FX, track, page, group or parameter; both OK and Escape resume that same position. Launching Preferences directly from REAPER's Action List closes back to REAPER instead. - **Shortcuts**: independent FX Params and Track Params keymaps, capture new keys, speak occupied combinations immediately without a confirmation dialog, and commit changes only on OK (Ctrl+Enter is also available). The dialog supports Alt+Tab and ordinary Windows focus changes. - **Messages**: editable title templates. FX Params provides four titles: FX Params, FX Memories, FX Browser, FX Pin Connector. Track Params provides twelve titles: Track F1, Sends F2, Receives F3, FX TCP F4, Track MIDI F5, Hardware outputs F6, ReaRoute F7 and five Track Memories headings. Tab first selects a title, then its component list. Space toggles a fixed component, Alt+Up/Down changes its order and Enter edits the optional custom text. - **Advanced**: REAPER SDK accelerator (recommended) or main-thread keyboard hook (compatibility), persisted in `LReaParams/Preferences.ini`.
## Track Params: F1 track-selection behavior
- A first **Shift+Up/Down** selects the *current* track, announces "Selected" and does not move. Further Shift+arrow presses extend the selection to adjacent tracks. - **Shift+Space** adds/removes individual tracks. Ordinary arrows can move the current cursor without discarding an explicit multi-selection, permitting separated groups of selected tracks (for example, 3, 4, 7, 9, 11, 12) for multiple Send or Receive destinations. - Ordinary arrows with only one implicitly selected track do not announce "Selected" on every move; Tab reports the selected track concisely.
## Compatibility and release history
- Existing `.fx`, `.tp`, Used-project state and earlier per-plugin preferences remain compatible. The old Plugin/Track title-order preference is migrated into the new title layout where applicable. - FX/Track navigation, the 14 independent FX grids, Keyboard mode, Used in F7 and prior MIDI/routing operations remain available. - The 0.0.69 and earlier release notes remain unchanged. No existing GitHub tags or historical ReaPack versions are removed or overwritten. - The original `Tools\push_lreaparams.cmd` is the supported push path. On publishing a **stable GitHub Release tagged `v0.0.70`**, the existing `Publish LReaParams to ReaPack` workflow builds the standalone DLL from that tag and regenerates `index.xml` from **all** eligible published releases. A source push by itself only runs the normal Windows build.
## Installation
Build and test the **0.0.70** Windows x64 Setup with GitHub Actions; attach the matching installer ZIP to the **v0.0.70 stable release**. ReaPack will update automatically after the release publisher succeeds. Never attach an installer from a different version.

# LReaParams 0.0.72 — Empty Titles and Explicit Step Saving
**Release date:** 17 November 2026 **Platform:** REAPER x64 · Windows x64 **License:** GPL-3.0-only
## What's New
- **Empty titles stay empty.** When every title component is disabled in Preferences, no implicit `FX Params` or `Track Params` caption is forced back in. - **Alt+S saves the current parameter Step.** Step adjustments no longer automatically replace the previously stored value. Saving is now an intentional action in supported FX and Track contexts. - **Improved title customization.** Retains the independently configurable FX plugin Type and Name components introduced in version 0.0.71. - Preserves existing keyboard shortcuts, preferences, parameter configurations and profiles.
## Installation
Download and run the Windows x64 installer attached to this release.
## ReaPack
Publishing this stable release triggers the existing automated ReaPack workflow.
The workflow builds the standalone `reaper_lreaparams.dll` and regenerates `index.xml` from all eligible published releases, preserving previous versions.
